# v1.2.1 / 111 Beta Synchronization

The 111 Beta release integrates formal main through PR #226, plus the shared
v1.2.1 release/download documentation. It retains the existing 111 signatures,
CardPlay propagation, potion-factory targets and canonical encounter handling.

The 109-only ShinGetterSavedPropertiesPatch is intentionally not included:
111 removed SavedPropertiesTypeCache. Its SavedProperties.FromInternal uses
ModelIdSerializationCache.GetJsonPropertiesForType, so the 109 cache injection
and packet-width repair have no corresponding target. The original 109-only
component fixture remains documented as 109-only; it is not a Beta test.

The runtime delta from the previous Beta target is limited to the latest
fake-merchant portrait layout and event-opening voice classification. The audit
inventory was regenerated: 326 C# files, 125 dynamic calls, 378 game types,
700 direct members, 33 generic members and 26 reviewed changed-symbol groups.
No new game API adaptation was required. BGM investigation remains deferred.

Manifest: v1.2.1-beta.111; minimum game: 0.111.0.
Asset: shin-getter-mod-v1.2.1-beta.111.zip, attached to mod-v1.2.1.
The Beta commit is recorded separately in the release because the formal tag
identifies the formal 109 source, not the Beta source.

Validation: compilation against the verified 111 DLL and issue#93 API/metadata
check passed. No Beta gameplay regression was requested or performed.
